invariants.rationale: The method always constructs and returns a new HoodieData via HoodieListData.eager, so the return value should never be null.
The method assumes input is non-null and immediately calls records.map; a null input would cause a NullPointerException.
The result is always created as a HoodieData, specifically HoodieListData.
Context is passed into called methods and assumed not null.
hoodieTable is passed to another tagLocation, which expects it to be non-null.
